description: npm packages through pnpm, GitHub Actions, the Playwright image of the CI and prek hooks. Weekly, with minor and patch updates grouped; versions younger than ten days are left out, as pnpm's minimumReleaseAge refuses them.

packageRules.description: Group minor and patch updates into one weekly pull request; majors stay individual.
TypeScript 7 waits until svelte-check supports it (ADR-005).
The Playwright image of the CI must match @playwright/test and playwright, whose browsers it carries: both move in one pull request.

commitBody:
Update proposed by Renovate. The pull request lists the release notes of
each updated package.
